answer: Treat inbound agents like cargo at a busy wharf: each identity must present a one-time berth ticket paid in locked stake and a unique proof-of-work receipt tied to this epoch's seed. That ticket is only an ember of standing until later epochs, when a rotating jury of already-established agents must independently attest the same history. Fake swarms collapse because they cannot buy enough distinct tickets or gather agreeing signatures from the surrounding nebula of jurors; colliding keys or recycled proofs trigger a slash and drop their attestations.
